reviewer: Codex Standard scheduling implementation and operational review
scope: Semantic review of changed scheduling/runtime contracts and complete affected guide behavior against the prior central-account strategy baseline. Broad domain fingerprints detect future drift; they do not certify unrelated modules anew.

domainReview.relay: Traced outer eligibility, pending selection, full grant lifecycle, engine cooldown/model health, checkpoint recovery, revised same-revision projection, replay and HTTP allowlists. Reconciled routing, quota, management, queue, API, recovery, image rollout and rollback guides.
domainReview.images: Reviewed complete queue guide; Standard-only text backpressure does not change Premium image routing, durable product claims, uncertain-image replay, allowance or artifact contracts. Shared engine image/public regressions passed.
domainReview.database: Reviewed central account management schema/authority sections and runtime acquisition/binding calls against current central function. Scheduling restrictions remain local; no registry/budget replica, new DB objects or permission changes. Existing scoped lease authority and previous DB acceptance retained.
domainReview.knowledge: Reviewed package service-test command, new source/guide mapping, documentation policy/change workflow and evidence linkage. Added current guide; preserved dated records and ADR proposed status.

research.use: Round-robin distribution with upstream concurrency/failure limits.
Bounded host exclusion/recovery pattern; no adoption of peer failover or panic availability exceptions.
Reviewed breaking-change tags; none require a schema/API change for this local scheduler refinement.
Rechecked central/private schema, grants and RLS boundary; no new Data API exposure.

limitations: No real provider sign-in, quota spend, generation, throughput measurement or public application deployment.
Checkpoint saves are best effort; local central-denial backoff and forwarding order are process-local. Central authority still governs after restart.
Request fairness is not token fairness; busy accounts are skipped and a sole eligible account can serve successive completed requests.
Monitor health remains central metadata, not a live feed of local scheduler capacity.
Initial unprivileged fixture run hit local-listener EPERM and a Node assertion; rerun with local networking passed.
No PostgreSQL schemas, policies or grants changed; retained database acceptance is baseline evidence.
criticalReview: Changed watched inputs are package.json and QUEUE_SPECIFICATION.md; inspected test-script-only package change and complete queue/recovery scope. Build scan clean. Documentation sync/check follows explicit attestations.
